body: Eel-like, conductive surface tissue, stacked electrocytes, ampullary sensory organs, rust-colored dorsal scales.

chains.trait: Electrocytes produce 300V shock in brackish water.

skill.effect: The creature lashes out with a sharp electric shock that briefly stuns its target. Nearby enemies in brackish water feel the sudden jolt and freeze in place for a short while.

chains.weakness: Shock range drops by 70% in high salinity.

journal.en: A serpent of lightning that fears the deep salt.

plausibility.summary: Keep the voltage as a short close-range pulse from a large electric organ with a recovery cost, label the lineage highly speculative, and make sure the shock fails in brine as the next chain says.
fixes: Keep the voltage as a short close-range pulse from a large electric organ with a recovery cost, label the lineage highly speculative, and make sure the shock fails in brine as the next chain says.

analogues.organism: Electric eels and knifefish, electric catfish and torpedo rays, independent evolutions of electrocytes; electric eels adjust discharge to water conductivity.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

links: High ion concentration causes current leak

skill.effect: When surrounded by thick brine, its electrical organs short-circuit and it cannot unleash any electric attacks. Its defenses weaken noticeably, leaving it more exposed to incoming strikes.

chains.weakness: Trapped in brine pools without attack options.
observe: Body twitches but no spark in brine

journal.en: The salt steals their fire; they are powerless in the deep brine.

plausibility.summary: No biological fix needed; phrase the penalty as lost offence plus a brief exposed twitch while current shunts, rather than literal loss of armour.
fixes: No biological fix needed; phrase the penalty as lost offence plus a brief exposed twitch while current shunts, rather than literal loss of armour.

analogues.organism: Electric fish lose discharge effectiveness as water conductivity rises and tune their output to the medium.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

links: Finds hidden prey in murky water

skill.effect: The creature senses faint bio-electric fields and reveals any hidden targets nearby. Its strikes land with greater accuracy against those it detects.

chains.weakness: Sensitivity overloaded by lightning; stunned for 1 turn.

journal.en: They see the spark of life itself, blind to the world.

plausibility.summary: Add F16 as a co-root, explain the glow as a symbiont or reflecting structure if you want to keep it, and keep lightning as a genuine overload.
fixes: Add F16 as a co-root, explain the glow as a symbiont or reflecting structure if you want to keep it, and keep lightning as a genuine overload.

analogues.organism: Sharks' and rays' ampullae of Lorenzini; electric fish use electroreception for prey detection and jamming avoidance.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

chains.trait: Dorsal scales match hematite rust color.

skill.effect: Its rust-colored scales blend seamlessly with the murky brackish water, making it nearly invisible at first glance. Enemies struggle to spot it until it moves or attacks.

chains.weakness: Obvious against blue/green backgrounds (rare but possible).
observe: Ambushes prey that walk right by

journal.en: A shadow that wears the color of the sky.

plausibility.summary: Add F16/F17 as co-roots for rusty silt and acid basins; no biological change needed.
fixes: Add F16/F17 as co-roots for rusty silt and acid basins; no biological change needed.

analogues.organism: Cryptic colour matching in flatfish and other sediment-dwelling fish; animals matching iron-rich soils.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

relations.note: (council kind 'predator') Sidero-chisp hunts juvenile or sick siderogons in lagoon margins.
(council kind 'exploit') Sidero-chisp may use sidero-copa shade to ambush, but avoids toxic dew.

changelog.what: re-review: the referee had failed (Cursor composer-2.5 unavailable on the Free plan) and every chain defaulted to 6/fixable; verdicts redone with a working referee

secrets: Harvest electrolyte glands: Sidero-chisp tissue can be used to craft shock tools.
Lightning rod behavior: Sidero-chisp can be lured into lightning strikes to stun them.
Brine trap: Luring a sidero-chisp into a brine pool makes it defenseless.
moments: A shadow splits the mist, then the water boils with violet light. Sidero-chisp strikes, and the lagoon falls silent, save for the fizz of settling ions.
